svg.title: Flow matching diagram and GLASS examples
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the provided figure. Base frame f01 contains a flow/sampling schematic with labeled trajectories and velocity arrow. Base frame f02 contains the pretrained flow matching pipeline with statistic, denoiser and transform arrows. Base frame f03 contains three-row comparison examples with Flow thumbnails, GLASS thumbnails and prompts. No SAM assets were supplied, so photo thumbnails are represented with native SVG vector approximations.

g.desc: Inside f01: origin-like reference is x_t near the center-left; dashed gray sample construction connects start samples, x_t, and lower path. Maroon curved flow trajectories move toward black end dots. A blue velocity vector u_s points right from a small blue point on the upper trajectory. Labels Start x_s=0, Sample N(gamma x_t,I_d), x_t, x_t', s=0, s=1 and Velocity u_s(x_s|x_t,t) surround the curves.

Inside f02: input statistic S(x_t,x_s bar) is below an upward arrow to denoiser D_t; another upward arrow leads to u_t. A black left-pointing transform arrow from u_t points toward the left diagram velocity field. Small text explains pretrained flow matching model and transform.

Inside f03: three comparison rows. Row one shows a sandwich alone in Flow, and a sandwich next to a backpack in GLASS, with prompt text to the right. Row two shows a black kite and green bear, and row three shows a bicycle/racket pairing. Photo regions are vector approximations bounded by f04-f09.

g.text: a photo of a black kite
